# Chapter 7: AI for Financial Management

## The Financial Management Challenge for Small Business

Financial management is the backbone of any successful business—yet for many small business owners, it remains one of the most stressful and time-consuming aspects of running their company. The constant juggling of cash flow, the anxiety of tax season, the complexity of financial reporting—these challenges can overwhelm even the most experienced entrepreneurs.
